query:
WITH RECURSIVE project_hierarchy AS (
            SELECT id
            FROM "Project"
            WHERE id = $1 AND "deletedAt" IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT child.id
            FROM "Project" child
            JOIN project_hierarchy parent ON child."parentId" = parent.id
            WHERE child."deletedAt" IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT id AS "id!" FROM project_hierarchy
